faq.title: Questions & answers
faq.a1: Mid-rate: x3 EXP, x3 Kinah, x2 Drop, x2 AP. Enough to enjoy the journey without months of grind.
faq.a2: No. The shop sells cosmetics, mounts, and convenience items only. No gear, no stones, no enchants.
faq.a3: Register on the site, download the client (~8 GB), launch and log in. Takes about 5 minutes plus download time.
faq.q4: Which patch version is the server?
faq.a4: Classic 3.9 — the most beloved era of Aion. All instances, sieges, and mechanics from this patch are working.
faq.a5: Dedicated servers in Germany. Average ping for EU players: 15-40ms.

faq.title: Common issues
faq.a1: Run as Administrator. Make sure antivirus is not blocking the file. Add the launcher folder to antivirus exceptions.
faq.a2: Update your GPU drivers. If using an AMD card, disable Radeon Anti-Lag. Try running in windowed mode first.
faq.a3: Server is in Frankfurt, Germany. If your ping is above 100ms, try a gaming VPN like ExitLag or Mudfish. Disable background downloads.
faq.a4: Delete the bin32/aion.bin.old file in your game folder. If it persists, run File Repair in the launcher.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1text: AionUCP is a non-commercial fan project. By using our service, you agree to these terms. The administration reserves the right to modify these terms without prior notice.
terms.s2text: Each user is entitled to one account. Multi-accounting is allowed within 2 simultaneous connections (dual box). Selling, trading, and transferring accounts to third parties is prohibited.
terms.s4text: Violations are punished with a warning, temporary or permanent account ban depending on severity. Use of cheats, bots, and exploits results in a permanent ban without warning.
terms.s5text: All donations are voluntary and non-refundable. Toll currency is purchased to support the project. The administration does not guarantee permanent server availability. No refunds are issued.
terms.s6text: We store minimal data: email, password hash, last login IP. Data is not shared with third parties. See the Privacy page for details.
terms.s7text: AionUCP is provided "as is". We are not liable for loss of game data, server downtime, or any damage related to the use of the service.
terms.r1: Use of third-party software (bots, cheats, macros, speed hacks)
terms.r2: Exploiting bugs and vulnerabilities (report them instead)
terms.r3: Kill trading and consensual AP farming
terms.r4: Insults, racism, threats in chat and forums
terms.r6: Real money trading of game items and currency (RMT)

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.collectIntro: When you register and use the service, we collect:
privacy.c1: Email address (for registration and password recovery)
privacy.c5: Game activity (characters, items, statistics — stored in game database)
privacy.storageText: Passwords are stored as SHA-1 hashes (game client requirement). We recommend using a unique password not shared with other services. Data is stored on dedicated servers in Germany.
privacy.sharingText: We do not sell, share, or provide access to your data to third parties. Exception: law enforcement requests in accordance with applicable law.
privacy.cookiesText: We use session cookies for authentication and CSRF protection. No analytics cookies are used. No third-party trackers.
privacy.ri1: Request deletion of your account and all associated data
privacy.ri3: Change email and password in your dashboard
privacy.contactText: For privacy inquiries, contact us via Discord or administration email.
